title: Circle Developer Grants
description: Grants for teams building on Arc and the Circle Developer Platform: milestone-based USDC funding, co-marketing, technical guidance, and Circle ecosystem access. Focus areas: agentic economic activity, stablecoin FX, peer-to-peer payments, treasury management, prediction markets, and lending and borrowing. The current round is Circle 2026 Cohort 2.
reward: Tiered, milestone-based USDC funding (amount per grant not stated; Cohort 2 shows $200K available)
ideas: An agent that settles payments in USDC on Arc
A peer-to-peer payments app using Circle Wallets
A lending or borrowing protocol built on Arc
rules: Rolling: Circle 2026 Cohort 2 is open on the grants portal. No closing date is stated.
Arc must be core to your flow of value, liquidity, or settlement, and Circle products (e.g. USDC, Wallets, CCTP, Nanopayments, Gateway) must be meaningful building blocks.
Circle prioritizes teams with proven shipping ability and evidence of usage, pilots, partnerships, revenue, or a credible path to get there.
Payments are released as agreed milestones are met and approved, not up front.
Process: application, initial review, finalist technical review (with screenings), milestone design, then disbursement.
Selective: as of Oct 7, 2026 the Cohort 2 portal showed 850 proposals and 14 accepted.
Qualifying Arc builders can also get security audit funding through Developer Grants.
